description: Ahrefs is an SEO toolset (backlinks, keywords, site audit) offering an API for programmatic data access.
access_notes: Official docs note the older API v2 has been deprecated in favor of a new access model (Ahrefs Connect / API for Developers). A third-party report specifically tested API availability 'on a Standard plan' (not just Enterprise), suggesting it's not strictly enterprise-only, but this was not independently confirmed against an official pricing page in this pass -- API access requires an underlying paid Ahrefs subscription either way.
api_notes: Backlinks, keywords, site audit, and rank-tracking data -- exact current v3-era endpoint breadth not independently verified after the v2 deprecation.
main_blocker: API recently migrated (v2 deprecated); current plan-tier requirements and full endpoint breadth not fully re-confirmed from official sources in this pass.
